summary: Nine tasks, strictly sequenced, all inside tools/ga-gate/ plus one spec file. They close M1 (the false green printed inside check-single-compose), M2/R7 (the seven unfloored gates: three floored, one floor named, three false accusations absolved by widening the detector, ratchet to 0) and M3 (an unregistered gate wired after its ARM B predicate is repaired).
